{{infobox Chinese|l=Yin Water Pig|kanji=癸亥|romaji=mizunoto i|onyomi=kigai|p=guǐhài|w=kuei-hai|mi=kʷeɪ̯²¹ xaɪ̯|y=gwai2 hoi6|j=gwai2 hoi6|ci=kʷɐi hɐi|mc=kjwɨj ɣəi|oc-bs=kʷeʔ ɢəʔ}}
{{Sexagenary cycle}}
'''Yin Water Pig''' (癸亥, ''mizunoto i''; onyomi ''kigai'') is the 60th of the sixty combinations of the {{ill|Sexagenary cycle|en|Sexagenary cycle|qid=Q246658|lt=Sexagenary cycle|1=Sexagenary cycle}}.

It is the 60th of the sixty stem-branch combinations, preceded by {{ill|Yang Water Dog|ja|壬戌|1=Yang Water Dog}} and followed by {{ill|Yang Wood Rat|ja|甲子|1=Yang Wood Rat}}. The {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stem|1=Heavenly Stems}} ''癸'' is Yin Water, and the {{ill|Earthly Branches|en|Earthly Branches|qid=Q1072961|lt=Earthly Branch|1=Earthly Branches}} ''亥'' (Pig) is Yin Water; together they form a Biwa (Mutual Harmony) relationship in {{ill|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|en|Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)|qid=Q218652|lt=Wuxing|1=Wuxing (Chinese philosophy)}}.

==Pronunciation==
* English: Yin Water Pig (癸亥)
** Chinese (Mandarin Pinyin): guǐhài
** Cantonese (Jyutping): gwai2 hoi6
** Japanese:
*** Kun'yomi: mizunoto-i
*** On'yomi: kigai
** Korean (Revised Romanization, Hangul): gyehae (계해)
** Vietnamese (Hán-Việt): Quý Hợi

==Months of Yin Water Pig==
In a {{ill|Common Era|en|Common Era|qid=Q208141|lt=Common Era|1=Common Era}} year whose final digit is 3 or 8 (when the {{ill|Heavenly Stems|en|Heavenly Stems|qid=Q1190985|lt=Heavenly Stems|1=Heavenly Stems}} are {{ill|Gui|ja|癸|1=Mizunoto (癸)|lt=Mizunoto (癸)|2=ja|3=癸|4=zh|5=癸|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Gui}} or {{ill|Bo|ja|戊|1=Tsuchinoe (戊)|lt=Tsuchinoe (戊)|2=ja|3=戊|4=zh|5=戊|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Bo}}), the month of {{ill|October|en|October|qid=Q124|lt=October|1=October}} is designated as the {{ill|Month|en|Month|qid=Q5151|lt=month (calendar)|1=Month}} of {{ill|Kigai|ja|癸亥|1=Yin Water Pig|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kigai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}. However, here the term "month" may refer either to the month of the {{ill|Lunisolar|ja|旧暦|1=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|11=Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Lunisolar}} or to the {{ill|Solar term|en|Solar term|qid=Q1190993|lt=Solar term|1=Solar term}} (from {{ill|Lidong|en|Lidong|qid=Q1191018|lt=Beginning of Winter|1=Lidong}} until the day before {{ill|Daxue (solar term)|en|Daxue (solar term)|qid=Q337815|lt=Heavy Snow|1=Daxue (solar term)}}) as applicable.
==Days of Yin Water Pig==
The {{ill|selected day|ja|選日|1=Senjitsu|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/selected day}} for {{ill|Kigai|ja|癸亥|1=Yin Water Pig|2=ja|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kigai|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} is the last day of {{ill|Hassen|ja|八専|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Hassen}}.
